bio.text: Eugene Vindman represents Virginia's 7th District and sits on the Armed Services and Agriculture committees.
He came to the U.S. with his family as a refugee from Soviet Ukraine at age 4 and was commissioned through ROTC.
He served as an Army infantry officer and then as a JAG Corps lawyer, including as a White House National Security Council deputy legal advisor, retiring as a Colonel in 2022 after 25 years.
